name: Bitter Reaches
summary: Along Azshara’s northeastern cliffs, the Bitter Reaches rise above the Great Sea. Predators roam the heights, and mountain giants hold the northern ridges.

sections.title: A Dangerous Coastal Frontier
sections.body: The Bitter Reaches rise above the Great Sea along Azshara’s northeastern cliffs. Feral hippogryphs and two-headed chimaeras nest among the heights. Acidic oozes seep through the cold ground, while colossal mountain giants claim the high northern ridges. They drive lesser creatures away and make the frozen approaches perilous for a lone traveler.

sections.title: Flora of the Crags
sections.body: Mountain Silversage grows in sparse clusters on the crags. The rare herb clings to high rock faces and windy perches. Herbalists must avoid the giants and territorial chimaeras to gather it.

faq.answer: The Bitter Reaches cover Azshara’s northeastern cliffs and ridges above the bay.
Territorial hippogryphs, two-headed chimaeras, and oozes live in the region. Mountain giants roam its northern boundary.

faq.q: Why are there mountain giants here?
aliases: why are giants in bitter reaches
faq.answer: Ancient mountain giants claim the high northern peaks and edges of Azshara. They drive most local wildlife from their territory.

faq.q: What valuable resources grow in the Bitter Reaches?
faq.answer: Mountain Silversage grows sparsely on rocky outcrops and ridgelines in the Bitter Reaches.

angles.text: Mountain Silversage grows in a few places on the wind-battered heights of the Bitter Reaches. You must contend with chimaeras and giants to gather it.
The cliffside aeries of the Bitter Reaches are hunting grounds for wild hippogryphs and aggressive chimaeras native to this ancient coastline.
